ranks.rk.title: Ranks
ranks.rk.sub: Read, listen and make reels together
ranks.rk.outLine: Join a league of 15 readers this week. Only what the app checks itself counts.
ranks.rk.outSub: Sign in with Google to join this week’s league, the global board and boards with your family and friends. Only what the app checks itself counts: pages read for their full time, recitation really played, surahs finished and reels made.
ranks.rk.iPtsBody: XP has this violet mark. Everything you do in the app earns it. This week's XP decides your place in your league and on every board, and starts again from 0 when the week ends at Friday's Maghrib. All the XP you have ever earned gives your character its level. XP is never spent.
ranks.rk.eaPageSub: Counts once it has been on screen for its reading time ({t} min, set in Me → ⚙). Up to 60 a day
ranks.rk.eaFlawlessSub: Extra, for a new lesson with no mistakes
ranks.rk.eaDaySub: Once a day, for any of the above
ranks.rk.iLightBody: Light has the star. It comes from chests (goals, adhkar, prizes) and you spend it in the shop. Light never counts in Ranks, and XP never turns into Light.
ranks.rk.iLeagueBody: Each week you play with up to {size} people at your level. The leagues follow the Sahaba's journey in order: Dar al-Arqam, Hijrah, Badr, Al-Khandaq, Fath Makkah. A later league is only later in the story, never a better Companion. The week runs Saturday to Friday and ends at Maghrib on Friday, at your own Maghrib where you live. Leagues are made of people on nearby clocks, and results show once everyone's Maghrib has passed. The top {up} move up a tier and win prizes, the bottom {down} move down.
ranks.rk.iWhenBody: A few seconds after a page counts, a lesson is passed or a minute is played, when you are online. While Ranks is open, the board updates by itself.
ranks.rk.notLight: XP is your progress here and is never spent. Light (✦) from chests is for the shop and never counts in Ranks.
ranks.rk.ptPage: {n} XP a page read (after its reading time, up to 60 a day)
ranks.rk.ptMinute: {n} XP a minute of recitation played (up to 3 hours a day)
ranks.rk.ptReel: {n} XP a reel exported (up to 3 a day)
ranks.rk.ptLesson: {n} XP a Learn lesson passed (up to 20 a day)
ranks.rk.fair: Numbers are checked on our server: they can only grow as fast as real time allows, and dhikr taps and Light are never ranked.
ranks.rk.league: Each week you play in a league of up to {size} people at your level. The top {up} move up a tier, the bottom {down} move down.
ranks.rk.name: Your name on the boards
ranks.rk.nameSub: Up to 24 letters. Everyone on the boards sees it.
ranks.rk.notYet: Read a page or listen for a minute to join this week’s league.
ranks.rk.leagueNote: When the week ends, the top {up} move up a tier and the bottom {down} move down.
ranks.rk.empty: Nobody has XP yet this week. Be the first.
ranks.rk.noBoards: Make a board for your family, class or masjid, then invite them with a link.
ranks.rk.createSub: Up to 50 people. Everyone you invite sees each other’s XP this week.
ranks.rk.inviteText: Join my board “{name}” on Ayah Studio (code {code})
ranks.rk.offline: Could not load the ranks. Check your connection.
ranks.rk.badInvite: This invite is not valid any more.
ranks.rk.signInJoin: Sign in with Google to join
ranks.rk.lookSub: Pick an avatar. Photos are not used on the boards, so they stay clean and safe for everyone.
ranks.rk.privateTitle: Keep my reading between me and Allah
ranks.rk.privateSub: Others see you as “A reader” without your name or avatar, and you are left off the global board.
ranks.rk.privateOn: Private: others see you as “A reader”.
ranks.rk.rival: {name} is {n} XP ahead. About {pages} pages passes them.
ranks.rk.rivalTie: You are level with {name}. One page passes them.
ranks.rk.q.listen: Listen to {n} minutes of recitation this week
ranks.rk.q.days: Read or listen on {n} days this week
ranks.rk.questDone: Done: the bonus is in your XP
ranks.rk.wkSubUp: Top three move up. A new league starts today
ranks.rk.wkSubStay: Finish in the top three this week to move up
ranks.rk.wkSubDown: A new week, a fresh start. Every page counts
ranks.rk.goalAdd: Set a goal for the board
ranks.rk.goalSub: Pages everyone on the board reads together this week.
ranks.rk.goalDone: Goal reached: {n} pages together. Ma sha Allah!
ranks.rk.fairNote: XP measures effort in the app, not reward with Allah.
ranks.rk.freezeSub: Relights your flame for a day you missed. You have {n} of {max}.
ranks.rk.useFreeze: Use {n} kept freeze(s) to relight it
ranks.rk.shopWinSub: These cannot be bought. They are won in Ranks.
